record.title: Microduck left ankle bracket — 39.5 x 36.5 x 25.5 mm yellow U-bracket: Ø15/Ø14 seat for the 15x10x3 ankle bearing in one wall, XL330 horn diamond (4 x Ø2.2 on R6 + Ø5 centre) in the other, R16.3 heel hull, one vertical M2 for the foot
record.why: cad/part.py builds one valid solid and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against Pollen's own published mesh reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/ankle_left.stl: p95 surface distance 0.012 mm ref->ours / 0.011 mm ours->ref, max 0.081 mm, bbox delta [0.001, 0.0, 0.0] mm, 13/13 holes matched (out/refcheck/microduck-ankle-left/r3, re-run with --evidence 2026-09-01T19-03-54Z). The report is the ledger artifact.
record.origin_why: modelled by hand in cecad from measurements taken off Pollen Robotics' decimated visual mesh (CC BY-SA-NC sim asset) with cad-mjcf sections, cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders and the plane-cut loops in docs/sections.py (fits in out/measure/ankle/fits_ankle_left.txt); nobody has Pollen's CAD and no physical part has been measured. Admitted through the TRIAD.md door: evidence/ledger.jsonl + computed trust.json.
record.why_this_folder_exists: The left ankle of the Microduck is this bracket — the MJCF body `ankle_left` places mesh ankle_left once (yellow, rgba 0.980 0.714 0.004). The RIGHT ankle is its true mirror about x=0 (measured: p95 0.000 mm, max 0.0087 mm — out/measure/ankle/mirror-test.json) and lives in its own folder because it is its own SKU on the print plate. The assets also ship an OLDER variant ankle_l_v1.stl — a different, 10 mm wider part (bbox 39.5 x 46.5 x 25.4 vs 39.5 x 36.5 x 25.5) that no MJCF body references; it is deliberately NOT this part.

revision_question_answered.question: COMPARISON.html finding 4: two ankle revisions ship (ankle_left Y 36.5000 vs ankle_l_v1 Y 46.4981) — which is current?
revision_question_answered.answer: THIS one. ankle_left/ankle_right is the shipped, walking product; ankle_l_v1/ankle_r_v1 is the ROLLER variant's ankle, not a later revision of this part.
readings: MJCF inventory across all five of Pollen's model files
the vertical screw's (x, y) measured on four meshes and matched to its own counterpart to 0.0000 mm
the bearing pocket: Ø15.0000 here against Ø15.2000 on the v1
revision_question_answered.photographic_check: images/store/store_microduck-inside-the-box.png (the retail box: feet, no roller kit) and store_microduck-cream-standing-profile-left.jpg, read back 2026-09-02
revision_question_answered.caution: the 'v1' suffix reads as an older revision and is not one. Nothing in this repo should treat either ankle as superseding the other.
